args.sql: SELECT m.member_reg, m.member_fan_pivot, m.spend_usd FROM membershipandspending m LIMIT 5;

SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot, 
       SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) as total_gift_usd,
       SUM(i.sess_dur_min) as total_sess_min
FROM interactions i
GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot
ORDER BY total_gift_usd DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.events_member_pivot,
       (e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::int as online_events,
       (e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::int as offline_events,
       (e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::int as meet_att
FROM eventsandclub e
LIMIT 5;

-- Check EPS calculation per fan via membership link
SELECT m.member_reg, m.member_fan_pivot,
       (e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::int as online_events,
       (e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::int as offline_events,
       (e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::int as meet_att,
       ((e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::int * 1) + 
       ((e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::int * 1.5) + 
       ((e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::int * 2) as eps
FROM membershipandspending m
JOIN eventsandclub e ON m.member_reg = e.events_member_pivot
LIMIT 5;

WITH fan_fmi AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
        SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) AS total_gift_usd,
        SUM(i.sess_dur_min) AS total_sess_min,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) / NULLIF(SUM(i.sess_dur_min), 0) AS numeric), 2) AS fmi
    FROM interactions i
    GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot
),
fan_eps AS (
    SELECT 
        m.member_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
        ((e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::int * 1) + 
        ((e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::int * 1.5) + 
        ((e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::int * 2) AS eps
    FROM membershipandspending m
    JOIN eventsandclub e ON m.member_reg = e.events_member_pivot
),
whale_fans AS (
    SELECT fan_id FROM fan_fmi WHERE fmi > 20
),
event_enthusiasts AS (
    SELECT fan_id FROM fan_eps WHERE eps > 25
)
SELECT 
    f.nick_label,
    ff.fmi,
    fe.eps,
    m.spend_usd
FROM fans f
JOIN whale_fans wf ON f.user_registry = wf.fan_id
JOIN event_enthusiasts ee ON f.user_registry = ee.fan_id
JOIN fan_fmi ff ON f.user_registry = ff.fan_id
JOIN fan_eps fe ON f.user_registry = fe.fan_id
JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot
ORDER BY ff.fmi DESC;

WITH fan_fmi AS (
    SELECT 
        i.interact_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::numeric) / NULLIF(SUM(i.sess_dur_min), 0) AS numeric), 2) AS fmi
    FROM interactions i
    GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot
),
fan_eps AS (
    SELECT 
        m.member_fan_pivot AS fan_id,
        ((e.evt_participation->>'On_Evt_Att')::int * 1) + 
        ((e.evt_participation->>'Off_Evt_Att')::int * 1.5) + 
        ((e.evt_participation->>'Meet_Att')::int * 2) AS eps
    FROM membershipandspending m
    JOIN eventsandclub e ON m.member_reg = e.events_member_pivot
),
idol_superfans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f.user_registry
    FROM fans f
    JOIN fan_fmi ff ON f.user_registry = ff.fan_id
    JOIN fan_eps fe ON f.user_registry = fe.fan_id
    WHERE ff.fmi > 20 AND fe.eps > 25
),
professional_fans AS (
    SELECT user_registry
    FROM fans
    WHERE LOWER(demo_profile->>'Occu_Path') = 'professional'
      AND CAST(demo_profile->>'Age_Count' AS int) >= 30
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT isf.user_registry) AS idol_superfan_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT pf.user_registry) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT isf.user_registry), 0), 2) AS professional_percentage
FROM idol_superfans isf
LEFT JOIN professional_fans pf ON isf.user_registry = pf.user_registry;
